examples.description: List components on the main camera

contexts.name: scene.gameobject.components
contexts.summary: List components attached to one GameObject, optionally including readable property previews.

contexts.description: List currently loaded scenes in the Editor with name, path, build index, loaded state, dirty state, and active scene. Read-only; does not load, unload, save, or switch scenes.
contexts.name: scene.opened
contexts.summary: List currently loaded Editor scenes with active, loaded, dirty, and build index state.

contexts.description: Read URP renderer feature availability and configured feature names for the active/default render pipeline. If URP or a pipeline asset is unavailable, returns available=false with diagnostics and nextActions.
contexts.name: scene.renderer-features
contexts.summary: Report URP renderer feature availability and configured renderer data names.

contexts.description: Read current rendering statistics from UnityStats when available. If Unity's internal stats API is unavailable, returns available=false with diagnostics and nextActions.
contexts.name: scene.rendering-stats
contexts.summary: Report UnityStats rendering counters when the internal Editor API is available.

contexts.description: Read Volume components in the active scene with target GameObject reference, enabled state, global flag, priority, weight, profile reference, count, and pageInfo. Optional target filters by GameObject name or hierarchy path. Returns an empty list when UnityEngine.Rendering.Volume is unavailable. This context is read-only and does not modify render settings or Volume profiles.
contexts.name: scene.volumes
contexts.summary: List Volume components in the active scene with target object, profile reference, and pagination metadata.

contexts.description: List all test fixtures and test methods in the project.
contexts.name: tests.list
contexts.summary: Report Unity Test Runner discovery availability and diagnostics.
